title: Social conversations
scenario: You are in a friend role. Use English naturally in this social situation.

lines.text: What a lovely afternoon! How have you been lately?
Very well, thank you. I have been quite busy with school.
I understand. I have been working on a new project.
What kind of project? It sounds interesting.
I am developing new English activities for the students.
Furthermore, a social event for teachers would be a great idea.
I agree completely. Let's discuss the details over coffee.
If I had known earlier, I would have planned something already.
